title: Bir Viski Macerası: Meleklerin Payı
author: Burkay Adalığ
description: A lively introduction to the world of whisky, from its Celtic origins to today’s global culture. Adalığ blends history, production secrets, and a world tour of Scotland, Ireland, America, Japan, and India before closing with tasting guides and Turkey’s first “Whisky Aroma Wheel.” The perfect gateway for both curious beginners and seasoned enthusiasts.
english_title: The Angel’s Share: A Whisky Adventure
